messages.author: Priya Raghunathan
messages.text: Set 9077 is quarantined flake output — nothing from it counts. 9084 runs out of validity on the 15th, inside the horizon; an extension is Tobias's call, not ours.

messages.author: Hanna Solberg
messages.text: Lane 1's Monday AM is the 26.1 GA freeze verification, protected. If anyone wants an out-of-hours hotfix block, that is a separate request to me — nothing pre-approved.

messages.author: Ines Kowalczyk
messages.text: The receipts module was reverted on Friday, so it drops out. Whatever date we commit to Ashgrove has to be real.
